sources.title: FinAI-Trader: Sentiment-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning for Bitcoin ...
sources.snippet: Automated cryptocurrency trading requires strategies that adapt to high volatility, sparse rewards, and rapidly shifting market conditions. We present FinAI-Trader, a reinforcement learning framework that integrates Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with Large Language Models (LLMs) for decision support in financial markets.
